upheld.title: WebApp accepts ?status= in any letter case, which AC3 does not allow
upheld.detail: Orders.razor picks the selected status with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase, so /user/orders?status=paid selects 'Paid' and filters the list. upheld.requirement: Ticket AC3 (the six names exactly; anything else shows all with 'All' selected), compared with AC5, which grants ignoring case only to the API
